tools.name: getFormComplexity
tools.description: Extracts standard and custom forms deployed across the instance to evaluate structural UI complexity.

tools.name: getDormantFields
tools.description: Identifies UI Bloat by correlating custom fields against the SystemNote table to find fields with zero modifications in the last 12 months.

tools.name: getUiLatency
tools.description: Extracts UI page load times (Client, Server, and Network latency) by retrieving APM Page Time Details.
